model: wing + H-tail + twin fins from asb_model.airplane(); pod ignored by the VLM; no control-surface deflection; inviscid potential flow (no separation)

condition.alpha_source: aero_results.json trim_cruise.alpha_deg (AVL trim at cruise CL)

frame: CAD / review viewer frame: X forward from the wing leading edge, Y up, Z right (starboard), metres
streamlines_note: RK4 along the unit velocity direction, step 0.005 m, 400 steps, every 5th point kept; xyz is a flat list [X0,Y0,Z0, X1,Y1,Z1, ...]; s is |V|/Vinf at each kept point

downwash_at_htail.note: wing-only lattice: local flow-angle change at the H-tail quarter chord relative to the free stream (negative = downwash)
